label: All of these
description: AND for gates: `yes` is true when every wired input arrived and none is `false` (any other value counts as yes); otherwise it stays closed. Combines several conditions into the one wire a gate takes: `rude: judge.rude` beside `sure: judge.sure`.

outputs.name: yes
outputs.description: True when every wired input arrived and none was `false`. Closed otherwise, so `_should_flow` reads it as a no and `_should_not_flow` reads it as the yes.
